caseNameFull: Vacco, Attorney General of New York v. Quill

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 518 U. S. 1055.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of Wayne County, Michigan, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.
